name: open-mod
description: Turn a plain-language idea into a built and verified Slay the Spire 2 mod.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify STS2 mods from plain-language ideas.
interface.longDescription: open-mod interviews the user, writes a semantic spec, scaffolds a pinned RitsuLib project, authors the mod, builds it, and verifies it in Slay the Spire 2.
defaultPrompt: Use $modmaker to build an STS2 relic from my idea.
Use $modmaker to create and verify an STS2 character mod.
